$comment: The page list: path, title, description, next steps and the status line a page shows where its example cannot run yet. Everything else on a page comes from the sources.
name: Prism
summary: Prism builds your application into a holo, a content-addressed package that carries its own proof and provenance, and checks them before anything runs.

pages.title: Holo format
pages.description: The byte layout of a .holo file, its sections, digests and format revisions.

pages.title: Attestations reference
pages.description: The statement and envelope a holo's attestations use, the predicate types and their status.
pages.status: no holo carries a signed statement yet. Every predicate type in the registry is a placeholder, so no statement is captured on this page.

pages.title: Manifest reference
pages.description: Every table and key in prism.toml.
pages.status: no manifest schema exists in the spec package at this revision. This page is generated from it once one does.

pages.title: Lockfile reference
pages.description: Every field of the lockfile, from the schema the spec package publishes.

pages.title: Errors reference
pages.description: Every error code the runtime raises and every CLI exit code.
pages.status: the typed error classes are in the prism-code source and are not in the published 0.2.0. The table lists every code the source raises.

pages.title: CLI reference
pages.description: Every prism verb, its flags, its exit codes and its usage.
pages.status: the prism CLI has not shipped, so no verb output is captured. Usage and flags come from the stand-in description.

pages.title: prism-code at a glance
pages.description: Load a holo, dispatch an input and replay its examples from Node.js with the prism-code runtime.

pages.title: Load a holo
pages.description: Read a holo from a path, a URL or bytes and get an application you can inspect and run.

pages.title: Inspect a holo
pages.description: Read the manifest, digests, world and attestations of a holo without running it.
pages.status: `inspect()` is not in prism-code 0.2.0. This page gains an executed example when the runtime ships it. The declarations below are what a reader decodes.

pages.title: Check a holo
pages.description: Check digest, provenance, proof and world against a policy and get a verdict.
pages.status: `experimental_verify()` is in the prism-code source and not in the published 0.2.0, which checks the digest footer and every section label on load. It is experimental until the v0.6 freeze. No holo carries an attestation bundle yet, so every holo is P0 and the default policy fails it.

pages.title: Instantiate a holo
pages.description: Create a running instance with exactly the capability set you grant.
pages.status: `instantiate()` is not in prism-code 0.2.0, which runs each request on a fresh guest instance inside `dispatch()`. The world below is what an instance exports.

pages.title: Dispatch inputs
pages.description: Send one request to the holo and get its response.

pages.title: History and replay
pages.description: Replay the examples a holo carries and prove its behaviour unchanged.
pages.status: `history()` and `replay()` are not in prism-code 0.2.0. `acceptance()` replays the examples the holo carries and is executed below.

pages.title: Use a holo as a tool
pages.description: Wrap a checked holo as a Vercel AI SDK tool so a model can call it.
pages.status: `asTool()` is not in prism-code 0.2.0. This page gains its declaration and an executed example when the runtime ships it.

pages.title: Error types
pages.description: Every error the runtime throws and the code it carries.
pages.status: the classes are in the prism-code source and not in the published 0.2.0. `DeterminismViolationError` and `ReplayError` are defined and mapped, and nothing raises them until replay ships.

pages.title: Spec package
pages.description: The types, JSON Schemas, world file and format revision that every runtime is built from.

pages.title: Check in the browser
pages.description: Check a holo offline in any browser without loading the runtime.
pages.status: `@prism-code/verify` does not exist yet. This page is generated from its declarations once it does.

pages.title: Testing package
pages.description: Test code that drives a holo with a mock host, skipped time and scripted dispatch.
pages.status: `@prism-code/testing` does not exist yet. This page is generated from its declarations once it does.
